info.name: FreightLink API
info.description:
Complete request set for the FreightLink API (backend, ASP.NET Core).

**Quick start**
1. Import this collection and one environment (Local or Azure).
2. In the environment set `adminEmail`, `adminPassword` (ADMIN_USER_EMAIL / ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD from the server .env) and `internalApiKey` (INTERNAL_API_KEY).
3. Open the collection and press Run. Folders 00-14 execute in order as one happy path: register and onboard an agency, create a load, simulate the AI agent, confirm and accept the match, run the trip, invoice, pay and dispute it.
4. Deselect `ZZ - Optional / Manual` before running: those requests change shared state or need emailed tokens.

Every request sets its own bearer token from collection variables (`adminToken`, `shipperToken`, `agencyToken`, `driverToken`) filled by the login requests, and saves ids (`loadId`, `tripId`, ...) for later steps. File-upload requests use `samples/`: in the Postman app set Settings > Working directory to this folder, or reselect the file.

**Roles:** Admin, Shipper, AgencyStaff, Driver. Internal agent endpoints use the `X-Internal-Api-Key` header instead of JWT.

item.name: Trigger AI Match (calls the real agent service)

request.description: Runs the real LangGraph pipeline in the agent container (uses OpenAI/OpenRouteService when keys are configured, which costs credits). The backend waits about 35 seconds; a slower run returns 503 AGENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE even though the agent may still finish, so follow with 'Get Match Recommendation'. 409 if the load already has an approved/active match.
Needs a workflow run in AwaitingApproval (a run finished by the real agent). 409 for runs that are still Running.
Same precondition as Reject Match.
Only Proposed assignments can be declined; 409 once accepted.

request.description: One invoice per trip: 409 once the on-delivery invoice exists. Use a trip without an invoice to get a Draft.
Only Draft invoices are editable; 422 for the Paid invoice from the happy path.
422 when the transition is not allowed from the current status.
Paid invoices cannot be voided (422).
400 when the dispute is already in the target status (it was resolved in folder 12).
Suspension is final: a suspended agency cannot be re-verified or re-activated (409), which is why this uses the throwaway agency created in folder 03, not your working agency.
Idempotent: returns 200 with deleted=false if the id is unknown.
